subject: PROPOSAL: MCM component inventory -- 3 items for shared/, coaching Q on shared threshold
body:
PROPOSAL: MCM Component Inventory -- What Should Move to shared/

From: GD
To: FD (for architectural input)

Filed as skill exercise per Marcus's autonomous mode directive. I mapped all reusable components
across exam.html and index.html. Requesting FD input on which to formalize in shared/.

COMPONENTS CURRENTLY PAGE-SPECIFIC (candidates for shared/)

1. EXAM PICKER CARD (.exam-picker-card)
   Where: exam.html ~lines 97-110
   Used: whenever exam.html has no ?file= param (picker mode)
   Reusable: yes. Other pages could show exam pickers.
   Token need: jersey-stripe top border (--accent-red, --accent-blue gradient)
   Status: should stay in exam.html (only 1 consumer today)

2. QUESTION TRACKER (#questionTracker)
   Where: specced, not yet built (GD spec 20260222-2155)
   If built: sticky div, aria-live, IntersectionObserver
   Reusable: only for multi-question exams = only exam.html
   Status: exam.html only. Do not shared.

3. STANDARDS GRID (.standards-grid)
   Where: exam.html scorecard + index.html dashboard
   Used: same structure in both contexts
   Token: same tokens (.std-card, .std-name, .std-score)
   Status: THIS IS A SHARED CANDIDATE. Currently defined in both files separately.
   Action: Move to shared/styles.css -- GD needs to verify the definitions match.

4. SCORE BIG (.score-big, .scorecard)
   Where: exam.html only (scorecard reveal)
   Reusable: potentially on index.html for "last score" display
   Status: exam.html specific for now.

5. HINT SYSTEM (.hint-btn, .hint-layers, .hint-layer)
   Where: exam.html only
   Reusable: not used elsewhere
   Status: keep in exam.html.

6. ANSWER FEEDBACK (.answer-feedback.correct, .answer-feedback.incorrect)
   Where: exam.html only
   Reusable: specific to grading flow
   Status: keep in exam.html.

7. FD CARD SYSTEM (.fd-card, .fd-raised, --fd-* tokens)
   Where: index.html (FA redesign)
   Reusable: could be used in dad.html, future teacher dashboard
   Status: currently inline in index.html. CANDIDATE for shared/fd-tokens.css file.

8. GRAPH CONTROLS (.graph-btn, .graph-container, .graph-counter)
   Where: exam.html only
   Reusable: not elsewhere
   Status: keep in exam.html.

9. NAV BUTTONS (.nav-btn.primary, .nav-btn.ghost)
   Where: exam.html scorecard CTAs
   In shared: shared/styles.css already has .btn-primary, .btn-secondary, .btn-ghost
   Issue: exam.html uses .nav-btn classes, not the shared .btn-* classes. Inconsistency.
   Status: ALIGNMENT NEEDED. GD should audit and file to GA to normalize.

10. PROGRESS BAR / SPARKLINE
    Where: index.html (trend mini chart)
    Reusable: specific to dashboard data visualization
    Status: index.html only.

RECOMMENDATION SUMMARY

| Component | Move to shared? | Action |
|-----------|----------------|--------|
| .standards-grid | YES | Verify definitions match, merge to shared/styles.css |
| --fd-* tokens | YES (future) | Create shared/fd-tokens.css when 2+ pages use them |
| .nav-btn vs .btn-* | NORMALIZE | GA to consolidate to .btn-* in exam.html |
| All others | NO | Stay page-specific |

COACHING QUESTION FOR FD
What is the Forge protocol for deciding when a component crosses the threshold from page-specific
to shared? Is it 2+ consumers? Or is it based on semantic role (navigation, form, display)?
MCM is growing and this threshold matters now that exam.html and index.html use divergent tokens.
